title: PickupWatcher
description: Never miss an item pickup again!
body:
Requires Paper for ActionBar support.

A small utility plugin for showing item pickup notifications to the action bar (or optionally chat, if you're a masochist). You can also mute these notifications for yourself with /pickup mute.

See config for setup details!

See the source [on GitHub](https://github.com/baph-omet/PickupWatcher).

![Preview image of the plugin. Text above the hotbar reads "Picked up Bread (17)"](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/fghuH59B/images/592ea146966051854869221788074fe7efa1296d.png)
